feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Trump staffing changes post-midterms signal he's battle ready
entry.summary: President Trump is making changes to his inner circle that signal how he may approach divided government.

entry.title: How will Democrats approach foreign policy after their midterm win?
entry.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Thomas Wright, senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, about his piece in Foreign Affairs titled The Fight for the Future of Democratic Foreign Policy.

entry.title: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
entry.summary: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, who will lead a caretaker government while negotiations take place, said: "I think everyone's over politics so let's all have a bit of a break for the next three weeks".

entry.title: NPR's Moscow and Beijing correspondents discuss the reaction to U.S. elections abroad
entry.summary: The results of the U.S. midterms were closely followed overseas. NPR correspondents in Moscow and Beijing discuss how the elections are seen in the countries they cover.

entry.title: Republican consultant discusses what went wrong and what's next for the GOP
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe speaks to Hogan Gidley, a Republican consultant and former White House Deputy Press Secretary during the first Trump administration, about the GOP's post-midterm strategy.

entry.title: Historically red state legislatures have flipped. Here's what's on their agenda
entry.summary: Democrats made sweeping gains in state legislatures across the country. We look at North Carolina and Arizona to see what that could mean.

entry.title: Week in politics: Democrats plan for the next Congress, Trump's new Chief of Staff
entry.summary: Democrats plans for the next Congress, where they'll hold significant majorities in both chambers. Meanwhile, President Trump signals his plans by promoting Stephen Miller as his new Chief of Staff.

entry.title: How Gen Z voters helped fuel a blue wave for Democrats
entry.summary: Republicans made gains with young voters in 2024, but in this year's midterms Americans under 30 issued a strong rebuke of President Trump and his party, voting decisively for Democrats instead.

entry.title: Trump says he was just kidding about making UFC's Dana White his press secretary
entry.summary: President Donald Trump said Sunday he was only kidding about making UFC boss Dana White his next White House press secretary

entry.title: Texas's 'Blue Tsunami' has former Texas congressman Beto O'Rourke 'over the moon'
entry.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with former Texas congressman Beto O'Rourke about how past efforts by him and other Democrats helped the party win big in Texas in the midterms.
